liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Far From Me** (2 reviews): Far From Me was hot, with Brent standing out; Live Far From Me usually lacks the studio version's power, but reviewer really enjoyed this one [16][20]
- **Space** (2 reviews): Bobby made a whip-crack sound on MIDI guitar, and Jerry answered with his own sonic attack; Jerry switched to a strat for a great Space; Brent hammered the keys wildly [17][21]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Bertha closing the first set is a rare placement [15]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Samson and Delilah was a ripping version [15]
- **Cold Rain And Snow** (1 review): Cold Rain & Snow opening set two suited the weather outside [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd89-04-17 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **gd89-04-17 t02 Iko Iko**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **gd89-04-17 t03 New Minglewood Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **gd89-04-17 t04 Row Jimmy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **gd89-04-17 t05 Far From Me**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **gd89-04-17 t06 Built To Last**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **gd89-04-17 t07 Victim Or The Crime**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **gd89-04-17 t08 Bertha**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-04-17.141003.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.pcm.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 150 min [1]
- **gd89-04-17.aud.wiley.9207.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 135 min; rated 3.9/5 by 10 [5]. Said about its sound: Crisp highs, somewhat muffled but distinguishable lows [15]
- **gd89-04-17.partial.aud-unknown.stairs.24003.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 117 min; rated 3.12/5 by 8 [8]. Said about its sound: Disappointing sound; levels run hot in places. The alternate audience source has more crowd noise near the mics but is slightly preferred [14]
- **gd1989-04-17.149521.s2.senn441.boedicker.flac1644**: source not stated; 11 songs; 84 min [9]

## Around the show

- Cold outside weather, but sweltering inside the Met; it was the final night of the tour [16]
- Per Deadbase, MIDI guitars first appeared onstage, only during Space; Bobby and Jerry laughed at their new sounds [17]
- Reviewer drove up from Des Moines, got a speeding ticket, arrived late, and the band was already into Victim [19]
- Jerry played MIDI guitar for the first time [9]
- Says the first Victim Or The Crime was actually 6/17/88 [14]
- Says the first Victim Or The Crime was 6-17-88 at this same Metropolitan Sports Center in Bloomington [18]
- Calls 1989 an underrated year; the band re-energized after the In the Dark craziness, with solid consistent playing [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-04-17.141003.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.pcm.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master Audience PCM (Nakamichi DMP-100 deck); Schoeps CMC4/MK4 mics, ortf (OTS); Transfer Info: Master PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM… [1]. Also: A short 0.8-second patch in Iko Iko comes from an AKG 451 source [1]
- **gd89-04-17.aud.wiley.9207.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>DAT>CDR [5]
- **gd89-04-17.partial.aud-unknown.stairs.24003.sbeok.shnf**: source: Source - 1st set MAC>C>C>D>cdwav>SHN [8]. Also: This partial audience recording lacks the first-set Iko Iko and Minglewood; another audience source includes them [10]
- **gd1989-04-17.149521.s2.senn441.boedicker.flac1644**: taped by Dave Boedicker; transferred by Dave Boedicker; source: Source:Sennheiser 441 Mics>Sony WM-D6C Cassette Deck>Maxell MX-90 Minute Metal Cassette Master Tape>Sony TC-D5M Cassette Deck(Playback)>Edirol R-09 HR(24/44.1… [9]. Also: First-set master tape was eaten during a transfer; only the second set survives, and the encore is missing [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1989-04-17 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1989-04-17-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [23]
